name: Cross-stage disagreement
description: Direct discordance between Tabular ML, Vision/Seq DL, and NLP/SLM

name: Resistance pattern
description: Acquired bypass resistance mutations emerging under targeted therapy

name: Conflicting clinical signals
description: ECOG performance status contradictory to acute laboratory markers

name: Rare mutation co-occurrence
description: Dual or multi-driver co-occurrence with < 0.5% cohort representation

name: Dataset coverage gap
description: Clinical phenotypes unrepresented in historical training cohorts

name: Conflicting biomarkers
description: Contradictory biomarker signals (e.g. high ctDNA vs normal CEA)

name: Low-confidence prediction pattern
description: Inputs that trigger model epistemic uncertainty (confidence < 0.50)

name: Rare adverse event
description: High-severity toxicities with low base-rate (e.g. immune pneumonitis)

name: Temporal complexity
description: Compressed or rapid multi-line treatment progression trajectories

name: Sparse biomarker region
description: Biomarker values in sparse upper or lower percentile tails

name: Underrepresented mutation
description: Single driver mutation with < 3% cohort representation

name: Unusual treatment history
description: Non-standard sequential switching across multiple drug classes

name: Negation-heavy text
description: Complex multi-clause clinical sentences with nested negations

name: Missing clinical information
description: Partial clinical charts missing critical genomic or lab values
